MarketLens

Open live website ↗Stock research
SwiftUI / Swift Charts
Python / scikit-learn
Yahoo Finance

Search for a stock, compare its price history, and keep a watchlist. The Python version compares Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and Ridge Regression forecasts against a no-change baseline.

The iOS version has native price charts, period statistics, and a client for the Python forecast service.

SwiftUI source ↗Repository ↗
02

StreamLens

Open live website ↗Netflix catalogue analysis
SwiftUI / Swift Charts
CSV import / JavaScript
On-device analysis

A dashboard for exploring a Netflix-style catalogue: release years, genres, production countries, and ratings. Import a CSV and filter the results without uploading the file to a server.

There’s a native iOS version too, with a Files importer and Swift Charts. The demo uses labeled sample data; it doesn’t measure Netflix views or engagement.

SwiftUI source ↗Repository ↗

A note on the builds

Both iOS projects compile in Xcode, and their focused Swift analytics checks pass. Simulator interaction testing is still pending because the development machine’s simulator runtime and SDK don’t match. Neither app is on the App Store yet.

The public MarketLens app runs the earlier JavaScript forecast. The Python ML service is prepared for Render and needs to be deployed separately. Forecasts are experimental, not investment advice.
